Spotlight-stage, a warm rosy theatrical beam landing on a ballerina mini-doll center-stage while the surrounding set fades into a soft lilac dimness.

Lavender dusk, a cool purple-blue ambient from the side suggesting twilight, kissing pale brick faces with violet and leaving warm ivory in the shadow creases.
Mint-fresh side, a soft cool mint-green fill from the left complemented by a whisper warm blush on the right, the fresh pastel-duet balance light.

Stardust overhead, a soft diffuse silver-white top with the faintest lilac tint dusting every upward-facing stud-surface like a sprinkle of gentle imaginary stardust.
